description: Manage the cold-reference knowledge corpus. Use when: registering, listing, reading, routing, granting, denying, accessing, consuming, or inspecting acquisitions of corpus documents (corpus_register, corpus_list, corpus_get, corpus_route, corpus_grant, corpus_deny, corpus_access, corpus_consume, corpus_acquisitions). Do NOT use when: writing Novel lore entries or secrets — use manage_lore. corpus_register, corpus_route, corpus_grant, and corpus_deny persist access state; revert with manage_history (action: undo); corpus_list, corpus_get, corpus_access, and corpus_acquisitions are read-only; corpus_consume records usage.

action.description: corpus_register, corpus_list, corpus_get, corpus_route, corpus_grant, corpus_deny, corpus_access, corpus_consume, corpus_acquisitions.

corpus_access_public.description: Whether every entity may consume it (corpus_register; default false).

corpus_domains.description: Knowledge domains the entity may access (corpus_access).

corpus_mode.description: read, research, taught, or import (corpus_consume; default read).

corpus_source_profile.description: Trusted source profile the domain is routed from (corpus_register; default manual).

entity_id.description: Entity to reveal to / whose knowledge to read (reveal/knowledge).

group.description: Group name, or null to clear (set/update/group).

name: manage_corpus

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Knowledge Corpus
